candidates.analyst_note: SMCI is the lowest-conviction name in this watchlist and is here only because it is in the universe with legitimate AI exposure. The accounting restatement resolved in December 2025 is a permanent mark against management credibility. There is no moat: SMCI assembles NVIDIA GPUs into servers, and so does Dell, Foxconn, Quanta, and HPE. The only reason SMCI trades at a premium is faster time-to-market in prior years — that advantage has eroded. If you own SMCI, it is a tactical AI hardware trade, not a strategic position. Size small, stop tight at $27.
